description: Read the offer for starting a new After Hours answering line: a phone assistant that picks up the calls an owner forwards from their own business number, takes messages and bookings and tells the owner. Use it before set_up_answering_line, to tell the owner exactly what they would buy. It covers the prepaid minute packs, the per-resolved-conversation packs, the billing rules and what happens when a balance reaches zero. It covers After Hours lines only: Direct credit costs are in get_m2m_network and an existing line's balance is in get_answering_line. Offered in: US. The values come from the same tables checkout charges from, so they cannot drift from what is billed. Takes no arguments, needs no sign-in, reads no account and changes nothing. Returns { product, packs[{id, minutes, cents}], per_minute_cents, min_billable_seconds, billing_rule, at_zero, outcome_packs[{id, outcomes, cents}], per_outcome_cents, outcome_billing_rule, outcomes_at_zero, countries[], owner_must[], terms_url, set_up_with, top_up_with }.
name: get_answering_line_offer
